verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document a tiered rate-limit system tied to spend, with automatic self-serve upgrades to higher permanent tiers as usage increases, satisfying the 'self-serve upgrade path' part of the story. However, there is no documented concurrency cap information, and no explicit numeric rate-limit tables or per-tier RPM figures are shown in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency cap documentation, concrete numeric rate-limit tables per tier, and independent confirmation of upgrade mechanics.
